# http-schema

> A parser for HTTP schema DSL. Declarative RESTful API configuration -> flat callable functions.

## Documentation

- [Main README](README.md): Project overview, installation, and usage guide
- [DSL Requirements](docs/01-requirements.md): DSL syntax rules and examples
- [Architecture Analysis](docs/02-old-xx-principle.md): Previous version architecture overview

## Specifications

- [Parser Design](docs/superpowers/specs/2026-08-08-http-schema-parser-design.md): Full parser architecture and design
- [Adapter Refactor](docs/superpowers/specs/2026-08-08-http-schema-adapter-refactor.md): Adapter de-internalization design

## Source

- [Entry Point](src/index.ts): Main httpSchema() function, request builder
- [Parser](src/parser.ts): Recursive DSL parser, items tree -> ApiItem[]
- [Resources](src/rest.ts): Resources CRUD expansion (normalizeResources)
- [Types](src/types.ts): Full TypeScript type definitions

- [Examples](__tests__/index.spec.ts): Integration test examples
- [Parser Tests](__tests__/parser.spec.ts): Parser edge case tests
